noInherit.description: If true, the annotation is not inherited by mixins.

sources.description:
Captures the set of types that should be denormed. When denormalize() is triggered,
data will be fetched from every type defined in this array.
The denormalized data will be saved in the type on which this annotation is defined.
Every item in the "sources" list should have mixed in Relation<T>. This facilitates
consistent and easy retrieval of input data.

target.description:
This must be specified on the vertexType.
It tells vertexType the name of type that stores the denormed hierarchy.

strictHierarchy.description:
false : The source contains first level denormed data. Each node can contain multiple parents (More like a graph)
true  : The source contains a "parent" field forming a strict hierarchy. Each node can have exactly 1 parent. (More like a tree)

title:
Main annotation to populate when creating a type that mixes in HierarchyDenorm. This type helps in indicating
properties for denormalizing the graph.
name: Ann.Denorm
